design_notes: Each seed has one initial point cloud and 17 independently sampled follow-up clouds. A random angle in each 45-degree sector is shared between its 1 and 2 km scenarios.
All methods consume the identical point cloud in each period. Across periods, samples are independently redrawn at the assigned centers.

Primary metrics are mean and P90 vector error by truth distance, the threshold report rates and origin sensitivity. Supplementary summaries include signed length bias, direction-sector results and paired cluster bootstrap intervals.
Sensitivity analysis changes only hotspot sigma from 1.2 to 2.0 km. Its results are separate from the main experiment.
